work.summary: I am currently working as a Data Mining Intern at GAO Tek Inc, where I am responsible for collecting and analyzing data to extract valuable insights. My role involves utilizing various data mining techniques and tools to identify patterns and trends that can inform business decisions.
highlights: Collected and analyzed large datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Developed data visualization dashboards to present findings to stakeholders.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement data-driven solutions.

work.summary: I worked as a Data Structure Practicum Co-Assistant at Artificial Intelligence Study Program, Universitas Negeri Surabaya (UNESA), where I assisted students in understanding and implementing data structures. My responsibilities included providing guidance and support during practical sessions, as well as helping students with their assignments and projects.
highlights: Assisted students in understanding and implementing data structures.
Provided guidance and support during practical sessions.
Helped students with their assignments and projects.
